FICTIONAL DEMO MATERIAL - NOT A REAL UNIVERSITY POLICY
1. Assessment Results and Review
The rules in this document are fictional test content. They must never be represented as official examination
regulations.
Requesting a review of an assessment mark
A student who believes that an assessment mark contains a recording or calculation error may submit a review
request within five working days after the mark is released. The request must identify the course, assessment
component and specific issue. A review checks the recorded assessment; it does not guarantee a mark change.
Minimum passing score
For the synthetic dataset, the minimum passing score for a course is 50 out of 100. This value is included only to
test retrieval of numeric facts.
Review outcome
The sample guide states that the review outcome is communicated through the Student Portal. It does not specify
a guaranteed completion time

2. Examination Registration and Conduct
Examination registration deadline
For the fictional assessment cycle, students must complete examination registration at least 14 calendar days
before the beginning of the examination period. The Student Portal displays the applicable registration window for
each assessment period.
Permitted materials
The relevant assessment instructions identify permitted materials for each examination. This generic
demonstration guide does not provide a complete list of permitted or prohibited items.
Absence and special circumstances
This sample guide does not define medical absence procedures, supplementary examination eligibility or fee
exemptions. The assistant must not infer those procedures from general knowledge.
Document status
Synthetic teaching material only. No actual university examination process is described.

Borrowing allowance
A demo student may borrow up to three books at one time. The standard loan period is 14 calendar days. One
renewal is permitted when no other reader has reserved the item.
Returns
Books should be returned to the library service counter or the designated return slot. This guide does not specify a
late-return fine.

2. Campus IT Helpdesk
Password reset request
A student who cannot access the fictional Campus Portal should submit a password-reset request through the
Campus IT Helpdesk portal. The sample workflow asks the user to provide the demo username and a short
description of the access issue. Never include an actual password in a support request.
Service availability
For this synthetic guide, the IT Helpdesk accepts portal requests throughout the day. The guide does not define a
guaranteed response time or emergency service level.
Contact details
The sample document does not provide a real phone number or monitored email address. Do not invent contact
information when answering questions.
Document status
This is a fictional document created to test PDF ingestion, passage retrieval, citations and cautious answer
generation.

Student Handbook - 2026-2027
Synthetic demonstration handbook | Version DEMO-1.0 | Issued 15 August 2026
FICTIONAL DEMO MATERIAL - NOT A REAL UNIVERSITY POLICY
1. Academic Participation
The fictional Northstar Demo University uses the following sample rules to test document retrieval. These
statements are invented for this prototype and do not describe any real institution.
Attendance requirement
For this demonstration dataset, students are expected to maintain at least 80% attendance in each registered
course. The synthetic policy does not define exceptions for medical or other special circumstances; the assistant
should not invent such exceptions.
Course add or drop period
Students may submit course add or drop requests during the first 10 calendar days of a semester. The request
must be completed through the fictional Student Portal before the published cut-off. Requests submitted after the
cut-off are marked as late and require review by the Academic Registry.

2. Academic Advising and Student Support
The fictional Student Advising Centre provides guidance on course selection, academic planning and referrals to
student support services. Students may request an appointment through the sample Student Portal.
Advising contact route
For this demo only, the sample contact route is advising@northstar-demo.example. This address is fictional and
is not monitored.
Information not included in this handbook
This page provides a short overview of the Student Advising Centre and the synthetic document status. It does not
describe accommodation or residential services.
Document status
This synthetic handbook is provided solely for classroom demonstration of PDF extraction, semantic retrieval,
source citation and evidence-based question answering.
